criteria.title: Equipment-group split
criteria.description: Assign whole equipment groups: E1–E4 to train, E5 to validation, E6 to test. Return train, validation and test lists of record_id in input order. Do not use target values to choose membership.

criteria.title: Baseline, linear and tree predictions
criteria.description: Fit a training-mean baseline, linear regression and a decision tree (max_depth=4, random_state=17) using load_pct and ambient_c only. Return three prediction lists under baseline, linear and tree. Feature records have no target. Fit preprocessing only on training data.

criteria.title: MAE and RMSE
criteria.description: Return mae and rmse, calculated over the same paired observations, with full precision.

criteria.title: Structured interpretation
criteria.description: Six scenario choices in DECISIONS; 5 marks for each correct choice.
